verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke nana Adam da rhe riẹn aye rọye Ivi, ọ da mrevun o de vwiẹ Ken, tanẹ, Mi vwiẹ ohwo vwẹ ọchuko rẹ Ọrovwohwo.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana adam da rhe rien aye roye ivi o da mrevun o de vwie ken tane mi vwie ohwo vwe ochuko re orovwohwo

verses.text_urhobo: Obọ rivẹ o de vwiẹ oniọvo rọye Ebẹl. Ebẹl na kẹ igodẹ ochurẹ, Ken otọ kọye o voro.
verses.text_romanized: obo rive o de vwie oniovo roye ebel ebel na ke igode ochure ken oto koye o voro

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ọke rhi vwo tere Ken da reyọ izobo rẹ emamọ rẹ otọ na vwo rhe Ọrovwohwo.
verses.text_romanized: re oke rhi vwo tere ken da reyo izobo re emamo re oto na vwo rhe orovwohwo

verses.text_urhobo: Ebẹl da je vwẹ izobo rẹ upene rẹ uchuru rọye rọ pha sọkọ sọkọ vwo rhe Ọrovwohwo. Ọrovwohwo de mu ọghọ kẹ izobo rẹ Ebẹl,
verses.text_romanized: ebel da je vwe izobo re upene re uchuru roye ro pha soko soko vwo rhe orovwohwo orovwohwo de mu ogho ke izobo re ebel

verses.text_urhobo: ẹkẹvuọvo ọ ri Ken o de no saka. Ivun de miovwi Ken gangan o de mu opharo phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o ri ken o de no saka ivun de miovwi ken gangan o de mu opharo phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ Ken, Die ivun vwo miovwo uwe, rẹ opharo wẹn vwọ dia tughẹ?
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta ke ken die ivun vwo miovwo uwe re opharo wen vwo dia tughe

verses.text_urhobo: Wọ riẹn ru nọ, ọ gbe rha jẹn wẹ reyọ? Wọ rha riẹn ru-u na, umwemwu fiọko vwọ anurhoro wẹn, wẹwẹ ọ guọnọ reyọ ẹkẹvuọvo pharhe wo phio kparobọ.
verses.text_romanized: wo rien ru no o gbe rha jen we reyo wo rha rien ru u na umwemwu fioko vwo anurhoro wen wewe o guono reyo ekevuovo pharhe wo phio kparobo

verses.text_urhobo: Ken da ta kẹ Ebẹl rẹ oniọvo rọye nẹ, Gbe jẹ avwanre kpo obo aghwa. Rẹ ayen vwọ obo aghwa re, Ken da vwọ so oniọvo rọye Ebẹl o de hwe ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: ken da ta ke ebel re oniovo roye ne gbe je avwanre kpo obo aghwa re ayen vwo obo aghwa re ken da vwo so oniovo roye ebel o de hwe ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ Ken, Tivọ Ebẹl rẹ oniọvo wẹn epha? Ọ da ta, Me riẹnre-e, mẹvwẹ re sẹro rẹ oniọvo mẹ?
verses.text_romanized: etiyin orovwohwo da ta ke ken tivo ebel re oniovo wen epha o da ta me rienre e mevwe re sero re oniovo me

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta, Die kọye wo ruru na? Urhuru rẹ ọbara rẹ oniọvo wẹn kperi nẹ otọ bru vwe rhe.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta die koye wo ruru na urhuru re obara re oniovo wen kperi ne oto bru vwe rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ enẹna a harhe owẹ eka nẹ otọ na rhe, ọto rhie unu rọye vwọ da ọbara rẹ oniọvo wẹn mie we.
verses.text_romanized: vwe enena a harhe owe eka ne oto na rhe oto rhie unu roye vwo da obara re oniovo wen mie we

verses.text_urhobo: Wo de voro otọ na, o gbi che yovwi emu kẹ wẹ-ẹ, ku wọ dia ọvwisusu kugbe osoghoro vwẹ evun rẹ akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: wo de voro oto na o gbi che yovwi emu ke we e ku wo dia ovwisusu kugbe osoghoro vwe evun re akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ken da ta kẹ Ọrovwohwo, Oja mẹ ọ rhonọ obo ri mi se chiri.
verses.text_romanized: ken da ta ke orovwohwo oja me o rhono obo ri mi se chiri

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe wọ djẹ vwẹ nonẹ na vwo nẹ otọ na re, Me da mrẹ opharo wẹn ki mi sioma nẹ, ke Me dia ọvwisusu kugbe osoghoro vwẹ evun rẹ akpọ na, ohwo kohwo rọ mrẹ vwẹ ejobi ko hwe vwe.
verses.text_romanized: nighe wo dje vwe none na vwo ne oto na re me da mre opharo wen ki mi sioma ne ke me dia ovwisusu kugbe osoghoro vwe evun re akpo na ohwo kohwo ro mre vwe ejobi ko hwe vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ nẹ, Ọ dia eriyi-in, ọ da dianẹ ohwo hwe Ken, ka re ihri akueghwrẹ vwẹ obọ rọye Ọrovwohwo da ka oka vwọi Ken, rere ohwo rọ mrẹrẹ vwo je hwe.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta ke ne o dia eriyi in o da diane ohwo hwe ken ka re ihri akueghwre vwe obo roye orovwohwo da ka oka vwoi ken rere ohwo ro mrere vwo je hwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ken da yan nẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo, ọ da ra dia otọ ri Nọd, vwẹ obọrhe rẹ Idẹn
verses.text_romanized: ken da yan ne obaro re orovwohwo o da ra dia oto ri nod vwe oborhe re iden

verses.text_urhobo: Ken da riẹn aye rọye, ọ da mrevun o de vwiẹ Inọk, ọ da fan orere, o de mu odẹ rẹ ọmọ rọye se, Inọk.
verses.text_romanized: ken da rien aye roye o da mrevun o de vwie inok o da fan orere o de mu ode re omo roye se inok

verses.text_urhobo: Inọk de vwiẹ Irad, Irad kọye ọsẹ ri Mẹhujael, Mẹhujael kọye ọsẹ ri Mẹtushẹl, Mẹtushẹl kọye ọsẹ ri Lamẹk
verses.text_romanized: inok de vwie irad irad koye ose ri mehujael mehujael koye ose ri metushel metushel koye ose ri lamek

verses.text_urhobo: Lamẹk da reyọ eya ivẹ, odẹ rẹ ọvo kẹ Ada, odẹ rẹ ọrivẹ ki Zila
verses.text_romanized: lamek da reyo eya ive ode re ovo ke ada ode re orive ki zila

verses.text_urhobo: Ada de vwiẹ Jabal, ọye ọsẹ rẹ ihwo re dia utughẹ ri ji churu uchuru.
verses.text_romanized: ada de vwie jabal oye ose re ihwo re dia utughe ri ji churu uchuru

verses.text_urhobo: Odẹ rẹ oniọvo rọye ki Jubal, kọye rha ọsẹ rẹ ihwo ri hworo isorogu vẹ owanre.
verses.text_romanized: ode re oniovo roye ki jubal koye rha ose re ihwo ri hworo isorogu ve owanre

verses.text_urhobo: Zila de vwiẹ Tubal-Ken; kọye ogun ro duvwu erọvwo kugbe utehru Oniọvo ri Tubal-Ken rẹ ọmọtẹ ki Naama.
verses.text_romanized: zila de vwie tubal ken koye ogun ro duvwu erovwo kugbe utehru oniovo ri tubal ken re omote ki naama

verses.text_urhobo: Lamẹk da ta kẹ eya rọye: Ada vi Zila nyo urhuru mẹ, ovwan eya ri Lamẹk kerhọ rẹ obo re Me ta. Mi hwe ohwo rọ wan vwẹ oma, emeghene rọ ghwiẹ vwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: lamek da ta ke eya roye ada vi zila nyo urhuru me ovwan eya ri lamek kerho re obo re me ta mi hwe ohwo ro wan vwe oma emeghene ro ghwie vwe

verses.text_urhobo: A da re ihri ri Ken akueghwrẹ, uyota ọ ri Lamẹk kẹ ujorha gbe ihwe akueghwrẹ.
verses.text_romanized: a da re ihri ri ken akueghwre uyota o ri lamek ke ujorha gbe ihwe akueghwre

verses.text_urhobo: Adam da rhoma riẹn aye rọye, o de vwiẹ ọmọshare o de se odẹ rọye Sẹt, kidie ọ tare nẹ, Ọghẹnẹ kẹ vwẹ ohwo ọfa vwẹ ẹdia rẹ Ebẹl ri Ken hweri.
verses.text_romanized: adam da rhoma rien aye roye o de vwie omoshare o de se ode roye set kidie o tare ne oghene ke vwe ohwo ofa vwe edia re ebel ri ken hweri

verses.text_urhobo: Sẹt de rhe vwiẹ ọshare re se odẹ rọye Inọsh. Vwẹ ọke yena yẹ ihwo ghwe mu odẹ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ese obọ.
verses.text_romanized: set de rhe vwie oshare re se ode roye inosh vwe oke yena ye ihwo ghwe mu ode re oghene ese obo
